REPORT ON Joseph Isaac Joseph or Mussri .

Made by D.S.I.Cruickshank . Forwarded by

Sir .

Re the attached correspondence .
The person Joseph Isaac
Joseph or Mussari when I know as Isaac Joseph , He resided with
Leon Barrat at No 930 Broadway for at least a week about the month
of April 1915. This is the same Leon Barrat as on Photo . I have
seen Joseph frequently in Barrats shop and on 2 occasions I saw
Ettinger in their company . Leon Barrat a Turkish Jew is certainly
a spy and Ettinger is one of the principal spy's in Shanghai . As
regards Joseph's or Mussri's registration number in the German
Consulate I am unable to verify, but I believe it is true . I know
there was a certain Russian Subject residing on the premises at
the same time as Joseph and would be in a good position to obtain
the information given , In fact I know it is quite correct that
Joseph Isaac Joseph Mussri is registered in the German Consulate
but I cannot divulge my information .

M.C. Satskin who resides at No 3 Yalu Road
This person is a female , She formerly kept a Coffee Shop at 112
Yangtszepoo Road for some years, I know her well, About 5 years ago ,
she left for Harbin where she said her Husband was a butcher. but
I have never seen him , She had a family of 1 girl and 2 sons . She
returned to Shanghai about 3 months ago without her family and
went into partnership in a so-called low class boarding house at
No 3 Yalu Road , She told me that her son was employed in the Post-
Office at Harbin and her daughter was in the employment of a

Made by D.S. Givens.    Forwarded by
Sir,
Regarding attached, I beg to report that A. Cohen owns
the Star Ricksha and Motor Car Co. His head place of business
is at No. 125 B.Well Road, and he resides in the upstairs portion
of that address. Cohen came to Shanghai eight years ago.
After coming here he started in a small way in the ricksha
business, but is now pretty well to do. He is a Turk by birth,
and, as far as I can learn, is a French protege. He is married
to a Spanish jewess.
Bernard Goldenberg, whose proper Christian name is Abraham,
Bernard being only a pet appellation, runs a cinematograph
show near the west gate of the city. He has lived in Shanghai
for about 15 years. Formerly he was assistant manager of the
Victor Theatre, and was later manager of the Olympic Theatre.
He held the latter position till he started business on his
own. He left 34 North Soochow Road about 7 months ago, since
when he has lived at 25 North Soochow Road. He is a Turk by
birth, but, as far as I can learn, is a French protege.
He has a brother in Manila named M.Goldenberg, who is an
American citizen. The latter visited Shanghai last week.
Your obedient servant,
J.H. Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.

Made by. D.S.I.Reeves. Forwarded by.
Chief Det ctive Inspector.
Sir,
I have received information that
Ettinger goes almost daily to the Russian Post Office and takes
delivery of letters addressed to him from Vladivostock and
Harbin. If the Russian Consul was notified perhaps these letters
could be examined.
I am also informed that there is at present living
with Ettinger, a Russian woman whose Jewish name is "Margnea",
who advertises that she is a teacher of Russian. This woman
has been known to make several trips to Harbin recently.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant.
Percy. W. Reeves.
D.S.I.

Sir,
D.S.I.Cruickshank reports that at about 9.20 a.m. on
the 20th inst he passed the shop of Leon Barrat the trunk
maker at 930 Broadway. He saw at that time a man clad
in a suit of silk pongee apparently of about 40 years of age,
about 5 feet 9 inches in height, stout build, with reddish
hair turning grey, red blotched face, closely cut reddish
grey moustache and beard, enter the house above mentioned
carrying a black leather letter case from which, when he
was inside, he took several documents. The first he
read over to Barrat. The two of them were seated at a table.
After the first paper which appeared to be a long letter was
read the reddish haired man produced what appear to be a plan
of some description on a paper about two feet long and one
in breadth. This was spread on the table and he and Barrat
lent over it and appeared to study it for over an hour.
Then the reddish haired man put the documents back into
the leather letter case, came out of the shop, went next
door (California Cafe) for a few minutes after which he

Sir,

Ettinger is living at No.30 D Nanzing Road. He is a Turkish Jew registered in the German Consulate.

Sir,
In continuation of my report of August 18th I beg to state that a frequent visitor to No.950 Broadway East bears the name of Moses Axelrat or Axelvrat. He is a Turkish jew registered in the German Consulate and he is undoubtedly a spy. He left Shanghai shortly before the war, went to Singapore, where it is alleged he obtained important photographs which he sold to the German Government. He has returned recently having been ordered away from British and French ports in the south. He is accompanied by a woman who passes as his wife. They stay at a boarding house kept by one Rosie Brandt at the corner of Yuhang and Miller Roads.
Dankert, the German, whom I referred to in my report as an associate of Barrat, has several aliases. He is known sometimes as Dunkerd, sometimes as De Leon, sometimes as Fuhrman and sometimes as Juhrman.
He acts as souteneur to an Austrian woman who has assumed the name of Miss De Leon and who keeps a brothel at No.6 Tiendong Road.
Barrat also had a woman in the same house who was known as Miss Führman. Barrat obtained Turkish papers and got her registered in the German Consulate. She is reported to be either a Russian or a Roumanian by birth.

a Turkish Jew registered in the German Consulate.

Gaston Kahn, Consul General De France,

Sir,

I wish to crave your indulgence for the lodging of a
complaint against one of your subjects namely a public prostitute
Carmen Puggioni, residing at No 10 Tiendong Rd, off Chapeo RD.
I may state here, that I am residing at No 930 Broadway East
Hongkew, and that I am a pianist by profession and employed
by the Victoria Hotel in Chapeo Rd. The above woman has
been persecuting me for a considerable time. Whenever she passes
my home she uses insulting words, and a verbal warning has been
without effect. She lives with a Senteneur, a Brasilian
subject, but a Russian Jew by birth, by the name of
T, Schaninski at No 777 Broadway East, a man whose antecedents
are well known to the Police of the Settlement.
I had occasion to lodge a complaint against this man, and
since the time this person has persecuted me with the lowest
insults, insults which only a low common woman of her stamp
can use. I am a German, Sir , but your name is so well known
in Shanghai for fairness and strict justice, that I take the
liberty of approaching you with the respectfull request, to
kindly use your authority and make the above mentioned woman
who by her behaviour is disgracing the name of a French-woman
desist from any further molestation of my person.
Thanking you kindly greatly for your kindness in advance.

I am Sir,
Your obedient servant
J. Dankert ( Pianist )
